No. | Components | Function
1 | Pattern Select Switch | Selects the Manual mode or the Normal mode for shift and lock–up timing.
2 | Crankshaft Position Sensor | Detects the engine speed.
3 | Park/Neutral Position Switch | Detects the shift lever position.
4 | Stop Light Switch | Detects if the brake pedal is depressed.
5 | Throttle Position Sensor | Detects the throttle valve opening angle.
6 | O/D Main Switch | Prevents up–shift to the O/D gear if the O/D main switch is off.
7 | Cruise Control ECU | This ECU prevents the transmission from shifting into O/D and prohibits lock–up control when the vehicle's speed drops below the cruise control set speed parameter.
